User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account settings, streak metadata, and privacy configurations.

displayName.description: The user's preferred name or pseudonym.

aiMemoryLevel.description: User's chosen AI memory depth level for reflections.

pinEnabled.description: Whether local app PIN lock is enabled.

pinHash.description: Hashed 4-digit PIN code for local unlock.

lastJournalDate.description: ISO date string of most recent journal entry or mood check-in.

JournalEntry.title: Journal Entry
JournalEntry.description: A private, distraction-free notebook entry with optional template answers and mood.

userId.description: UID of the author owning this entry.

templateType.description: The template category used for this entry.

templateTitle.description: Display title of the chosen template.

title.description: Optional title for the journal entry.

text.description: Full text body of the journal entry.

promptAnswers.description: Structured answers to template guiding questions.

aiReflection.description: Short, gentle 1-2 sentence reflection note generated post-save.

aiReflectionDismissed.description: Whether user dismissed the gentle reflection note.

MoodLog.title: Mood Log
MoodLog.description: Quick daily mood check-in dot for habit and emotional tracking.

userId.description: UID of user who logged mood.

note.description: Optional short note accompanying mood check-in.

WeeklyReflection.title: Weekly Reflection Summary
WeeklyReflection.description: Aggregated weekly reflection card with emotional curve and gentle open inquiries.

weekStartDate.description: Start date of the analyzed week.

weekEndDate.description: End date of the analyzed week.

moodTrendSummary.description: Gentle 1-2 sentence synthesis of mood patterns.

themes.description: 2-3 recurring themes noticed across the week.

inquiryAnswers.description: User's personal thoughts and answers responding to gentle inquiry questions.

userNotes.description: Optional open notes written by user on the weekly mirror.

entriesCount.description: Number of journal entries included in synthesis.

savedAt.description: Timestamp when reflection thoughts were saved or modified.

ReflectionChatSession.title: Saved Reflection Chat Session
ReflectionChatSession.description: Completed conversation with the AI Reflection Companion, stored as a dedicated dialogue record.

userId.description: UID of the user who engaged in the conversation.

title.description: Summary or title of the reflection chat session.

weeklyReflectionDate.description: Date range string of the weekly reflection.

firstQuestion.description: The initial reflection inquiry that kicked off the dialogue.

messages.description: List of user and AI messages exchanged in the session.

messageCount.description: Total count of messages in the dialogue.

summary.description: Optional short summary or key takeaway from the dialogue.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the conversation was completed and saved.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile settings, AI memory depth, and lock configurations.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Private notebook entries belonging to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/moodLogs/{moodLogId}.description: Daily mood check-ins for the user's dot trail.

/users/{userId}/reflectionChats/{chatId}.description: Saved completed conversations with the AI Reflection Companion.
